test_build_and_call_pedestal_model: test the SetTemperatureDensityPedestalModelTest class and its parameterized test for building and calling the pedestal model with various T_i_ped, T_e_ped, n_e_ped, and rho_norm_ped_top configurations
build_pedestal_model: build a pedestal model using torax_config.pedestal.build_pedestal_model() with set_T_ped_n_ped model name and configurable pedestal parameters
build_runtime_params: build runtime parameters using build_runtime_params.RuntimeParamsProvider.from_config() from a ToraxConfig instance
build_source_profiles: build source profiles using source_profile_builders.build_source_profiles() with runtime params, geometry, core profiles, and source models
initial_core_profiles: initialize core profiles using initialization.initial_core_profiles() with runtime params, geometry provider, source models, and neoclassical models
